_comment: Example only. Copy to config/digest-customers.json (git-ignored) and edit. Review the result with: node scripts/digest-customers.js. See docs/slack-digest.md.
_keys: customerSources: unit > sub-groups whose conversations belong to customers. anchorSources: where each conversation defines a customer (the success channels). mentionSources: scanned for customer mentions; leadership: true sets the Leadership flag. stripPrefixes/stripSuffixes/dropWords: how a channel name becomes a key. minContainLength: a key joins a customer when one contains the other and the shorter is at least this long. minAliasLength: shorter automatic aliases are not used for mentions. customers: names, extra keys (spelling or hyphenation differences), aliases for mentions, exactAliases (matched case-sensitively, for short upper-case names that are also ordinary words), and channels assigned by hand; a customer listed here with no success channel collects the channels whose key equals its own. notCustomers: general channels in the customer sources. otherBucket: customer-source conversations that are not customers (names or IDs); they get one brief summary under that name and are never ranked. noMention: automatic aliases never used for mentions.
